name: Morgana

facts.text: Morgana's forces overran Avalon with the drakoran; Arawn sent the Inconnu against her because she takes his dead.
Mythic's Catacombs lore: Merlin's honoured apprentice, she trapped him in a crystal in a cave of ley lines, now the Dark Spire, and attacked Avalon with the drakoran horde.

Level 90, at the fallen tower in Lyonesse with the demons Bechard and Silcharde. The Academy epic asks champions to kill the two demons, not her ('you are no match for Morgana herself'). When they die she swears she will return and that Camelot's walls will fall.
Her script calls Arthur her brother; in the legends she is his half-sister.

story: Morgana was Merlin's best pupil, taught in the colleges of Avalon, and Arthur's own sister, and she wanted his throne. When she could not take it she took his teacher: she lured Merlin to a cave where the ley lines meet and shut him in a crystal, and drank his power, and came back at the head of the dragon-men to burn the city that had taught her. She steals the dead from Arawn to fill her armies. In Lyonesse, at the fallen tower by the Telamon road, she is working a ritual that will summon an army onto Albion's own soil, and two demons, Bechard and Silcharde, stand guard over it. The Academy sends its champions to kill the demons and break the ritual. It tells them plainly not to fight her. She is not a thing a group of adventurers can kill. She is a thing they can delay.
legend: Do not fight Morgana. Kill Bechard and Silcharde, her two demons, and her ritual breaks; she will curse you, swear to return and leave. Every Academy mage who reached fifty has heard the same advice, and the ones who ignored it are not around to give it.

phases.text: My creations, undone! Heed me: I shall return!

slay: Is this all Albion has to offer?

lairEntry: A fallen tower. A woman's voice chants inside.

phases.text: Morgana's ritual breaks. Her demons are dead!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Morgana is driven from the fallen tower. For now.
